name: The Caldera Yard
frame: map metres, x east, y north, origin SW corner; yaw clockwise from north; hx along the pad's local x

sites.name: Caldera Yard + Rim Foundry
sites.comp: NEW 1: the Yard (capstone inside the Rim Foundry)
sites.size_note: MEASURED ground: your build-4 grid already has a flat shelf at 3.5 m here, 298 x 450 m (101,600 m2) but not square; the largest pad that holds 4 m on it is 240 x 340 m (280 x 380 m does not), against the purpose map's 'about 400 x 300 m'; a harbour work (dry dock and slipways reach the lagoon)
sites.stake: The CIS frigate yard: the reason the planet is held. The capstone interior is inside the Rim Foundry
sites.entrance_note: faces the road that serves it

sites.name: Breach Dam (east abutment and gate house)
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: the dam spans the breach (see the dam line); this is its east abutment and gate house, 80 x 60 m, on the south arm's tip (a harbour work)
sites.stake: The dam closes the breach; its gate opens the lagoon to Republic boats; its crest road is the only AI link between the two crescents

sites.name: Kameni Shield Generator
sites.comp: Destructable Shield Generator and its shield template
sites.stake: Its shield blocks air strikes on the Yard until it is blown; it stands on the black lava islet in the lagoon (boats or air)
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: South Arm Gun Line
sites.comp: CIS AAT Turbolaster Base with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 90 x 90 m (as op 3's Sound Rim Guns)
sites.stake: Guns on the south crest cover the lagoon and the dam; air softens them

sites.name: Yard Power Plant
sites.comp: CIS Large Power Facility with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 140 x 100 m (as op 5's Ridge Power Station)
sites.stake: On the rim above the foundry; it powers the foundry and the Kameni shield. Blowing it darkens the foundry's halls

sites.name: Dam West Tower
sites.stake: Covers the dam's west end on Ash Crescent's south tip
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Dam East Bunkers
sites.size_note: KNOWN as built: your 1-09 (Small Wall with Bunker) is a Small Rectangle FOB, 90 x 58 m
sites.stake: Cover the dam's east end and its gate house

sites.name: Inner Shore Fuel Quay
sites.comp: CIS Large Fuel Depot with GPs
sites.size_note: REDUCED: your built pad (2-M1, 248 x 261 m) holds 4 m nowhere within 720 m; this 160 x 120 m pad needs a trimmed composition. Was: REDUCED: the composition's own pad (2-xx) is 248 x 261 m and the inner shore takes no more than 160 x 120 m; a harbour work
sites.stake: Fuel for the Yard's tugs; it burns when hit and the tugs stop

sites.name: Crater Wall Depot
sites.size_note: REDUCED: your built pad (1-06, 134 x 248 m) holds 4 m nowhere within 720 m; this 80 x 60 m pad needs a trimmed composition. Was: ASSUMED: 80 x 60 m (as op 6's Signal Isle Depot); on the inner shore (a harbour work)
sites.stake: Reserve stores under the south-east cliffs; taking it gives a covered start line onto the inner shore road

sites.name: Kameni Vent Bunkers
sites.stake: Bunkers among the fumaroles guard Kameni's north landing
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: South Arm Road Tower
sites.stake: Holds the road from Causeway Foot along the south arm

sites.name: Akrotar Cape AA
sites.comp: CIS Medium AA Base with GPs
sites.stake: AA on the cape; taking it opens the southern air route over the dam

sites.name: Inner Shore Road Gate
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 2-07; on the inner shore road (a harbour work)
sites.stake: The inner shore road from the south into the Yard (through-comp)

sites.name: Dry Dock Pump House
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 82 x 65 m (the pad op 3 found); beside the Yard (a harbour work)
sites.stake: Floods or drains the dry dock; taking it strands the hull in the cradle

sites.name: South Crest AA
sites.comp: Medium Covered AA Base with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 120 x 110 m (a little under the Medium AA Base, 2-M3)
sites.stake: AA on the south crest; taking it opens the lagoon's south sky to LAATs

sites.name: Akrotar Dig (sheds and ramp depot)
sites.comp: CIS Elevated Ramp Depot with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Elevated Landing Pad Construction (2-01)
sites.stake: The CIS strips a buried ancient city out of the ash; the Yard's ammunition and droid store sits in the dig sheds (a big burn)

sites.name: Akrotar Dig (the temple dig)
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 80 x 60 m of dig beside the sheds
sites.stake: The CIS strips a buried ancient city out of the ash; the Yard's ammunition and droid store sits in the dig sheds (a big burn)

sites.name: Ash Crest Gun Line
sites.comp: CIS Small Artillery Base with GPs
sites.stake: Guns on Ash's crest fire across the lagoon at boats making for the Yard
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Ash Outer Depot
sites.stake: Supplies landed on Ash's outer slope for the crest guns; taking it opens Ash's west beach
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)
